manifest.selection_policy: Pre-registered final set: category/difficulty coverage was fixed before the final quality scoring. No task was removed because it failed. The list must not be changed after seeing final metrics.

evaluation_protocol.notes: Task-level and aggregate scores; failures and empty answers are retained, not filtered.

rubric.strict: all required facts + required source correct
rubric.token_normalization: Legacy langgraph/opencode sections use the last model response per successful turn. Full post-hoc accounting is in token_accounting and task_metrics: LangGraph sums all GENERATION observations; OpenCode sums proxy generations. Native/step_finish values are cross-checks only.

methodology.llm_calls_langgraph: logged GENERATION count + model retry attempts beyond the first (retry attempts without a separate generation are counted as calls, not as extra tokens)
methodology.tokens_langgraph: sum of input/output/cache across all Langfuse GENERATION observations for the task; includes summarization
methodology.llm_calls_opencode: sum of upstream attempt counts recorded by the proxy; includes extra/retry requests
methodology.tokens_opencode: sum across proxy generations; native and step_finish totals are cross-checks and are not added again
methodology.cost: direct API cost is zero for local Ollama; hardware and electricity costs were not measured
